Both point to elevated equity volatility and funding stress relevant to NSCC variation margin. V is 3 (PQD, DTCC public quantitative disclosure): the largest payment obligation to qualifying liquid resources for NSCC sits at level 3 of 5 versus its own history.
input.so_now_what: Watch daily VIX ratio values — the weekly peak of 1.54 was recorded Nov 5, 2026 — and the next quarterly PQD release for any movement in NSCC's payment-to-qualifying-liquid-resources measure beyond the current level 3.
